evidence.title: Drinking hot water, lemon and baking soda will not cure coronavirus
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as false the claim that drinking hot water with lemon and bicarbonate of soda at night cures coronavirus and explains Israel's low death rate.

evidence.title: No, Baking Soda And Lemon "Remedy" Did Not Cure COVID-19 In ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as false the claim that a baking soda and lemon remedy cured COVID-19 in Israel, leading to no deaths.

evidence.title: No, Vitamin C and lemon-infused hot water do not protect against ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as false the claim that Vitamin C and lemon in hot water protect against coronavirus.

evidence.title: Will Lemons and Hot Water Cure or Prevent COVID-19?
evidence.snippet_en: Snopes.com rated as false the claim that drinking hot water with lemons will cure or prevent COVID-19, or that adding sodium bicarbonate will "alkalize the immune system."
